name: holy-grail-layout
title: Holy grail layout
description: The classic page skeleton: header, navigation, main, aside and footer, with the footer pinned to the bottom of short pages.
docs: children is main; header, nav, aside and footer are optional and render as header, nav (named by navLabel), aside (named by asideLabel) and footer. In a layout 64rem wide the three columns stand side by side (navWidth and asideWidth, 14rem and 15rem by default); from 48rem the aside drops under main; below that the navigation is a block above everything and the aside comes last, in one column. The footer sits at the bottom of a page shorter than the screen: height is the screen (100dvh by default; give it a length to fill a box). stickyHeader pins the header, stickyColumns pins the navigation and the aside under it while main scrolls (they scroll inside themselves when taller than the screen, and they only pin where they stand beside main); headerHeight is the height of the header, 3.5rem by default. A skip link comes first and points at main (mainId, skipLabel, or false to leave it out). mainAs is main (the default) or div: a page has one main landmark, so a second layout on the page, a preview or a dialog uses div. classNames reaches each part. The layout is a size container, so it answers to its own width and works in a dialog or a preview.
